items.name: The Westin Xi'an
items.detail: Westin Studio, one king, non-smoking. Y1,464 + Y243.02 service = Y1,707.02 all in (~$240). Y732 prepayment charged 27 Sep; free to cancel until 23:59 on the 28th. 66 Ci En Road, Qu Jiang New District, +86-29-65686568 — opposite the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, Dayanta station on Lines 3 and 4. Line 4 runs straight to Xi'an Railway Station with no changes, which was the whole argument for this hotel.

items.name: The Westin Xi'an · award night
items.detail: One night on the 85k Amex Brilliant free-night award, taxes included, nothing to pay. Free to cancel until 23:59 on 17 Sep — but you need this night: the Z165 leaves at 09:27 on the 2nd. Ask the front desk to LINK the two reservations so you aren't moved rooms on the morning of the 1st. Platinum on both: 1,000-point welcome gift or F&B, lounge access, upgrade subject to availability, plus free entry to the hotel's own Xi'an Qujiang Museum of Fine Arts and free Hanfu wear.

items.name: Tibet tour hotels
items.detail: Included in the Asia Odyssey tour. Sharing a twin with Jeff — two separate beds, confirmed with James — so the RMB 2,100 single supplement falls to Kamana or Alka. Night of the 7th is the tent camp at base camp, 5,200 m.

items.name: Courtyard by Marriott Shanghai ITRZ
items.detail: ~Y499/night (~$70). On Disney Avenue, 900 m from the gate — a ten-minute walk, free shuttle if you book it with the concierge, and Disney Resort is the Line 11 terminus so the city stays one seat away. Platinum turns its paid breakfast into a free one. Four park days from downtown is ~400 minutes of metro; the same four from here plus a city day is ~120. Pudong is 25 minutes by taxi against an hour from People's Square. This is the largest open block on the trip.

items.name: Four Points Shanghai ITRZ
items.detail: Y485/night, 4 miles out. Marginally cheaper, meaningfully further. No reason to choose it over the Courtyard.

items.name: Shanghai Marriott Kangqiao
items.detail: Y1,012/night, 2.8 miles. Free Disney shuttle and a proper Platinum lounge at double the price, but shuttle-dependent, which cuts against travelling on your own clock.

items.name: Renaissance Yu Garden
items.detail: Y895/night, ~60 min to the park. Best-placed downtown hotel for the Bund and Yu Gardens at a fair price — only right if you flip the plan and make the city the point. Courtyard Shanghai Central is Y754 next to Shanghai Railway Station (easy Suzhou); Fairfield Jingan is the cheapest real brand at Y424.
